# Corsat Station
[italic]Date 2181 - Corsat Station, a Weyland-Yutani operated research and prison station.[/italic]
## Under Construction This page is still being written.
[bold]Corsat Station[/bold] is a research station on the outer arm of Herculis. Its exact purpose is classified, and the UA press is barred from reporting on it.
- Its main funder is [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"], which regularly contracts scientists to work in the station's separate environmental domes.
